scope: One pretraining seed and development subjects; natural widths primary, fixed projection secondary. Describes the 19618 endpoint only: no recommendation, no checkpoint selection, no further training.

reading.scope: Conditional on one training seed and development subjects. Separate marginal CIs; no joint 95% guarantee. An unresolved outcome is not equivalence; a worse outcome concerns this recipe at this dose, not scaling generally. The 5000 and 19618 readings stay side by side: no rule selects between doses.
